A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ICCD study. All seven pages of v1 and eight pages of v2, including equations, figures, tables, references, and Appendices A–B, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 4–5 report original accuracy experiments across seven NLU datasets, multiple Llama and Qwen models, and analyses of negative examples, demonstration counts, and α.

after.justification: v2 retains and revises the original experiments and adds TREC/Dbpedia results and an analysis of positive-versus-negative-context output distributions.

M1.justification: The negative-example construction and contrastive decoding equations remain unchanged. Section 2.2 corrects swapped positive/negative logit symbols in the explanatory prose to match the existing equation; this does not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: v2 adds TREC with six classes and Dbpedia with fourteen classes while retaining all seven original datasets. This is a targeted extension of classification coverage beyond the original two-to-five-class tasks.

E2.justification: Regular decoding remains the comparator in corresponding experiments. Random, BM25, and TopK selection strategies and the NULL/Label/Input ablation variants are retained. The added dataset experiments also compare ICCD against regular decoding.

E3.justification: v2 introduces average KL divergence between normalized positive- and negative-context output distributions as a diagnostic metric in Table 5. Existing accuracy evaluations retain the stated models, 16-shot default, α = 1, and appendix splits and templates.

E4.justification: Section 5 adds a diagnostic examining whether positive and negative demonstrations produce different output distributions, with per-dataset KL-divergence results. The existing negative-example, demonstration-count, and α-sensitivity analyses remain.

E5.justification: Table 1 newly reports standard deviations for ICCD across the three Llama models and three selection strategies; regular-decoding entries have dashes. Both versions already specify three runs with different random seeds, so this is additional uncertainty reporting, not a documented increase in runs.

E6.justification: The core empirical record is substantially revised through changed main accuracy and α-sensitivity results, plus new classification and KL-divergence results. For example, Qwen2-1.5B's Table 2 average changes from 75.4 to 74.6 against the unchanged 72.3 baseline. In Table 1, Llama3.2-1B with TopK changes from a 73.6 tie to 73.4 versus 73.6. New Table 3 reports Llama3.1-8B results of 46.6 versus 41.0 on TREC and 93.8 versus 87.5 on Dbpedia.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(4), their probabilistic formulation, and the underlying mathematical reasoning are unchanged. No formal assumptions, theorems, or proofs are added. The corrected logit symbols in prose align the explanation with the retained mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract reduces its numerical headline from up to +2.1 to up to +1.8 average improvement. Section 4 also lowers the claimed improvement across all model sizes from over 1.5 to over 1.0. The central training-free input-label-mapping contribution and broad applicability claims remain.

C2.justification: v2 interprets the new KL results as evidence that positive and negative contexts produce meaningfully different predictions and adds a performance-stability interpretation. The limitations newly acknowledge that additional forward passes may increase inference time despite parallel execution, and explicitly include machine translation among untested tasks.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces a future code-release promise with a repository address and a statement that code and scripts are released. v2 also newly states that the extra forward passes execute in parallel. Existing appendix split counts and prompt templates are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to prior in-context learning and contrastive decoding research are unchanged. The added experiments and analysis introduce no new cited comparison methods or revised novelty relationship.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized introduction and results edits, corrects the logit-symbol explanation, adds experimental and limitations paragraphs, and adds corresponding-author and acknowledgment text. The six-section narrative and Appendices A–B retain their structure.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains average/standard-deviation subcolumns, and new Tables 3 and 5 display the additional classification and KL results. Existing tables are renumbered and relocated; both figures retain their plotted content while moving within the same two-column layout.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly strengthens empirical support and transparency through additional classification tests, uncertainty reporting, the distribution diagnostic, a reported code release, and an explicit inference-cost limitation. The gains remain limited: baseline uncertainty is absent, the new datasets lack appendix split/template details, and a new prose-table mismatch remains—Section 4 claims a 1.8-point Llama3.1-8B MNLI gain, whereas Table 2 shows 67.5 versus 65.3, implying 2.2 points.
